authority.sole_worldstate_writer: CoreRPG; this code only emits nonauthoritative dispatch proposals
authority.clock: Host/CoreRPG-authorized virtual tick ranges; never wallclock, render frames or distance
authority.domain_evaluators: B01 to B09 remain domain owners; scheduler never duplicates domain rules
authority.orders: F11/HOST authorize commands independently; no offline grant is a live permission
authority.facts: Fixture status=accepted is synthetic and not cryptographic proof
authority.runtime: No CoreRPG transaction, persistent host daemon, UE5, galaxy-scale benchmark or network session provided

inputs.snapshot_version: v0.1.0 with same campaign_id and world_revision
inputs.intent: domain_intent must be externally accepted, owned by same B01-B09 domain and causally dated
inputs.b09: B09 task additionally requires an externally accepted need; projected B08 pressure is insufficient
inputs.clock: clock_advance accepted fact precisely authorizes [current_tick, target_tick], independently issued by core_clock
inputs.ack: dispatch_receipt accepted fact issued by core_writer, bound to dispatch ID and tick

configuration.budget_per_tick: positive bounded integer maximum number of dispatch proposals per game tick
configuration.per_domain_quota: positive <= budget_per_tick; fairness bound within each tick
configuration.max_batch_ticks: positive bounded limit for one catch-up call
configuration.max_pending_outbox: positive maximum unacknowledged envelopes; backpressure must preserve tasks
configuration.time_scaling: game-specific CoreRPG clock policy; scheduler cannot derive elapsed time from real time

state_machine.duplicate_policy: stable id p2b10:<campaign_id>:<task_id>; no double dispatch/ack; same receipt replays idempotently
state_machine.replay_policy: canonical JSON sha256, hash-chained journal, immutable source snapshot; runtime must add transactional snapshot fencing and signed provenance
state_machine.tick_order: strict virtual tick ascending; ready tasks sort by aging-adjusted priority, due tick, task ID
state_machine.on_failure: raise, do not commit mutated input; keep backlogged tasks and external facts

information.view: only actual dispatches with previously accepted, delivered recipient-specific evidence

required_runtime_integration: CoreRPG transactional, versioned source fact and command validation with real signatures
CoreRPG authoritative persistent clock/ticks, durable scheduler queue, recovery and atomic outbox
Consumer idempotency, exactly-once effects guarded by transaction IDs and revision checks
F11/HOST actor orders, game pause/sessions and multi-player authority
B01–B09 native event handlers/WorldState state transitions with rollback and audit
UE5/NAP/PADD observer-filtered knowledge, scene streaming and real save/load
Performance profiling across galaxy entity scales and catch-up windows
red_lines: No fictional fixture can attest live accepted CoreRPG facts
No changes to F13 global PLANIFICADA or layers 119 partial / 120 runtime blocked
No offscreen dispatch may directly grant rewards, war orders, population or market changes
